tips.text: Run the Exterminate node, not an endless one; the roll comes once per mission, so the shortest mission wins.
Pick Neptune Proxima for the fastest lap; its enemies are level 27 to 30, so a weak Railjack clears it.
Run Veil Proxima if you also want Corrupted Holokeys or Intrinsics; the lap is slower but pays more.
Build your Railjack and raise its Intrinsics first; a built ship laps in 5 to 6 minutes and an unbuilt one takes about twice that.
Do not spend Radiant relics or Reactant on this farm; refinement does nothing for the blueprint roll.
Check the star chart for an active Void Storm on Neptune, Pluto or Veil before launching; only a couple are up at once and you cannot pick the node.
Ignore advice to wait for Sevagoth in The Circuit; he is not in its rotation.
Collect Argon Crystal last, right before you start the Systems build; it decays after 24 hours.
Treat Sevagoth as a byproduct of a Railjack session you had another reason to run; chasing three specific drops is what makes people quit.
Expect one to two hours with a built Railjack at average luck; tails of seven hours or 70 storms get reported.
